### Dark mode

<Canvas of={AvatarStories.Dark} />

```css
.bg-dark {
  background-color: #111111;
}
.p-1 {
  padding: 1rem;
}
```

### Sizes

Predefined sizes are available from `xsmall` to `xxlarge`, which are the recommended minimal (24px) and maximal (112px) sizes.

<Canvas of={AvatarStories.Sizes} />

You can also resize the avatar to any size by setting `fontSize` css property.

<Canvas of={AvatarStories.Resize} />

```css
.avatar-size {
  font-size: 94px;
}
```
